title: markermd grading rubric
description: A markermd grading rubric: per-question rubric items and scoring setup used while marking in mark(). Contains no per-student grading data. A file may cover a single question or every question in a project. Format 1.1 adds item groups: an entry of a question's items list may be a group whose combined points are bounded by a floor and/or ceiling, or which allows only one selected item. Format 1.2 adds optional questions (scoring.optional).

format_version.description: Rubric format version: "1.0" (items only), "1.1" (items and groups), or "1.2" (adds optional questions).

name.description: Question name; must exactly match a question name in the project's grading template.

scoring.description: Optional scoring setup for the question. When omitted the project's existing settings are left unchanged.

items.description: Rubric items and item groups in display order. There is no limit on the number of items. Order is meaningful: counting a group's items in place, the first ten items are bound to keyboard hotkeys 1-9 and 0, and any further items are toggled by clicking.

total_score.description: Maximum possible points for the question.

grading_mode.description: "positive" builds the score up from 0 by adding selected item points; "negative" starts from total_score and applies (typically negative) item points as deductions.

bound_above_zero.description: When true the computed score is clamped to be >= 0.

bound_below_max.description: When true the computed score is clamped to be <= total_score.

optional.description: When true a repository with nothing recorded for the question counts as graded and scores as if no item were selected (0 in positive mode, total_score in negative mode) instead of being left ungraded. Meant for a document-level question that applies to only some submissions. Added in format 1.2; defaults to false.

points.description: Point value applied when the item is selected; negative values are deductions.

description.description: Feedback text shown for the item. Used as the cross-format identity key, so it must be non-empty and unique within a question (across all of its groups).

group.description: Group label, unique within the question. Shown to the grader; shown to students only when feedback is exported with group headings.

floor.description: Lowest the combined points of the group's selected items can go (a cap on the total deduction in negative mode). Omit for no floor.

ceiling.description: Highest the combined points of the group's selected items can go (a cap on the points earned in positive mode). Omit for no ceiling.

exclusive.description: When true at most one item of the group can be selected (severity tiers).

items.description: The group's rubric items in display order. Groups cannot nest.
